title: Revision impact selection
responsibility: Chooses recorded or source-derived impact and falls back to active-registry dependency comparison.

inputs.name: harnessImpact.base
inputs.description: Earlier revision the change is measured from, or undefined when no base is selected. A record or source impact applies only when it names this revision's commit; with undefined neither applies, and every active unit of head is then listed as added.

inputs.name: harnessImpact.head
inputs.description: Later revision the change is measured to; its comparison record applies only when it names base's commit, and so does its source impact unless a matching compared argument replaces it. Its registry is compared with base's registry when neither applies, and its commit must equal compared's head for compared to be used.

inputs.name: harnessImpact.compared
inputs.description: Optional comparedSides result for the same two revisions, where null or undefined means none was precomputed. Its impact replaces head's source impact only when its base and head commits equal base's and head's commits, and otherwise head's source impact is used.

inputs.name: comparedSides.client
inputs.description: The client whose side(path) call loads a stored side; comparedSides calls it for base's and head's side in parallel, so a rejected load rejects the result. It is not called when either side reference is absent.

inputs.name: comparedSides.base
inputs.description: Earlier revision whose stored side is loaded; when its side is undefined, null or empty, comparedSides returns undefined without loading anything. Otherwise its commit becomes the base of the returned pair.

inputs.name: comparedSides.head
inputs.description: Later revision whose stored side is loaded, under the same absent-side rule as base. Otherwise its commit becomes the head of the returned pair.

outputs.name: harnessImpact
outputs.description: The impact of the change from base to head, tried in order: a record comparing exactly base (source 'recorded'), the source impact that names base (source 'source'), then the added, removed, version-changed and transitively affected units of both active registries (source 'computed'). Groups are sorted with a unit listed as added never also direct, marks rank removed over added over direct over indirect, and computed impacts always have an empty uncertain list.

outputs.name: comparedSides
outputs.description: Resolves to the base and head commits with the source impact of their two stored sides, or to undefined when either side reference is absent. It rejects when a stored side fails to load, and a rejection from the impact analysis passes through unchanged.

errors.name: Stored comparison side load failure
errors.description: Thrown by the harness client's side loader, and so rejected by comparedSides, when a stored side's response is not ok: '<path> could not be loaded (<status>)'. A network or JSON parse rejection inside that loader, and any rejection from sideImpact, pass through unchanged.
